outline:
Course Description
Elements of ecosystems, biogeochemical cycling, environmental factor interactions, population dynamics, and community development.

Course Goals
This course is intended for students and will examine structure and function of ecological systems, including populations, communities, and ecosystems, role of evolution in structure and function of systems, and influence of society on the biosphere. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to:
1.	Understand major concepts and terminology in the field of ecology.
2.	Identify reputable sources for ecological information.
3.	Comprehend the methods and application of ecological research.
4.	Evaluate human interactions with nature and effects on natural systems.

category: 參與校內外活動(講座、工作坊、參訪)或競賽(Participation in on-campus or off-campus activities (lectures, workshops, visits) or competitions)
flexible_learning.content: 第17至18週採彈性學習方式進行，學生可依個人興趣與專業發展方向，自行選擇與課程相關之校內外專題演講、研討會、線上講座或學術論壇至少兩場參與。透過專家分享最新研究成果、產業發展趨勢及實務案例，培養學生自主學習能力，拓展專業視野，並將演講內容與課程知識相互連結，提升跨領域思考與終身學習能力。
flexible_learning.outcome:
學生須於彈性學習期間完成至少兩場演講之聆聽，並繳交每場約500字之心得報告，共計兩篇（約1,000字）。心得內容建議包含：

演講主題與內容摘要。
個人學習收穫與心得反思。
演講內容與本課程知識之關聯性。
未來可應用於學習、研究或實務工作之啟發。
